card.name: Words leading into 'sourced' or 'obtained from'
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected 'sourced', 'obtained from' or 'produced' phrase about where a material comes from. Seen on 'sustain<<ably>>', 'legally', 'be' and 'from' in sourcing sentences.

modes.label: Adverbs of sourcing
modes.description: Adverbs like sustainably, legally or illegally right before a word such as sourced, farmed or extracted.
modes.example: importing timber and wood products without ensuring they are<< legally>> sourced.

modes.label: Obtained from phrase
modes.description: Words inside 'obtained from the oil of fish' in omega-3 capsule descriptions.
modes.example: eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA), obtained<< from>> the oil of fish.

modes.label: Will be acquired or produced
modes.description: The word 'be' before a verb about acquiring or producing a fuel or energy supply.
modes.example: Methane needed to power the fuel cells will<< be>> acquired from carbon-neutral sources, such as

card.writes: It pushes toward words about origin and sourcing (source, sustain) and smoking, and away from assembly and cut.
card.plain: It lights up when a sentence is about to say where something comes from, such as 'sustainably sourced' or 'obtained from fish oil'.
